gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-noto-sans-arabic: Noto Sans Arabic has a pronounced x-height and generous openings in its small letters, which makes the text feel modern and tidy. Coming Soon adds the casual pen-and-paper side, its round o drawn with a constant wall, while the body keeps things crisp.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-noto-sans-armenian: Coming Soon looks bent from wire, every line the same thickness and a loose, personal hand behind it. Noto Sans Armenian follows in sans, with tall, full c, s and z and round letters that open wide.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-noto-sans-avestan: Noto Sans Avestan is modern and clean, with a tall x-height. Coming Soon draws its heading in one steady, unvarying line, so a small heading would lose that charm, while the sans text can go smaller.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-noto-sans-balinese: Coming Soon looks like bent tubing, casual and personal, with lowercase rising close to the capitals. Noto Sans Balinese gives it a professional partner in sans, short in its ascenders and spacious inside every curve.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-noto-sans-bamum: Casual and personal, Coming Soon is drawn with a thickness that never shifts, however the line turns. Noto Sans Bamum answers in plain sans, with big open counters throughout.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-noto-sans-bassa-va: Professional and contemporary, Noto Sans Bassa Vah is a sans-serif with a dominant midsection and a jaw-open c. And Coming Soon brings the handwritten side, every stroke cut to one width.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-noto-sans-batak: Steady pen pressure from the first letter to the last gives Coming Soon its casual, personal hand. Noto Sans Batak is the plain sans partner, its x-height towering and its e wide open.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-noto-sans-bengali: Contemporary and professional, Noto Sans Bengali is a plain sans whose capitals barely top its lowercase. And Coming Soon sets curves and stems in lockstep, a casual handwritten match for those open letter mouths.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-noto-sans-bhaiksuk: Approachable and professional, the lowercase here is swollen like tightly coiled rope. Noto Sans Bhaiksuki carries a text in plain sans with open apertures, while Coming Soon's round letters, drawn like bent wire, stay casual above it.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-noto-sans-brahmi: Handwritten heading, tidy text beneath. Coming Soon has stems matching hairlines because there are none, giving it casual personality, while Noto Sans Brahmi is a contemporary plain sans with a high mean line.
